target: pappus PO:0025393 + absent PATO:0000462 only in the ray florets (sterile, without a style). The disc florets' fruits carry a pappus of antrorsely hispid awns, so 'pappus: hispid' stands for them.

fix: 'absent dans la fleur ♂', 'absent in male / ♀ flowers' limits the absence to staminate flower PO:0025600 or pistillate flower PO:0025599. Never make a taxon-wide absence from a statement qualified by a sex symbol or word.

target: external ostiolar bracts absent (ostiole without external bracts); the basal bracts of the fig are present and partly deciduous

target: stamen PO:0009029 absent in pistillate flower PO:0025599, though sometimes a few are present (staminodes). Variable presence in female flowers.
